data.name: Century Paper & Board Mills Limited
data.description: Century Paper & Board Mills Limited was incorporated in Pakistan as a public limited company on August 2, 1984 under the repealed Companies Ordinance, 1984. The Company is engaged in manufacturing and marketing of paper, board and related products.
